name: Talorys
description: Deploys a private personal AI assistant to your own Cloudflare free tier, with memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, plus a token-scoped REST API for your scripts.

skills.name: Memory
skills.description: Keeps durable personal facts and preferences you can view, edit and delete, and tracks facts that change over time.

skills.name: Semantic recall
skills.description: Finds memories, tasks, notes and automations by meaning as well as keyword. Off by default.

skills.name: Automations
skills.description: Runs one-time and recurring reminders, daily task digests and optional AI routines on a schedule.

skills.name: Tasks and notes
skills.description: Manages tasks, notes and projects, and keeps working when the AI quota is used up.

skills.name: Remote MCP tools
skills.description: Connects remote MCP servers and asks for approval before tool calls that may change something.
